task: The dinner is almost ready! It's only missing a grilled apple.
description:
You find yourself in a bedroom. A standard kind of place. You start to take note of what's in the room.

You see a chest drawer. You make out a closed antique trunk nearby. You make out a king-size bed. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the king-size bed.

There is a closed wooden door leading east.

thought: I should go east through the wooden door to explore more rooms where I might find an apple and a grill or something to cook the apple.
feedback: You have to open the wooden door first.
